script.text: After Alexis fell under control of the Society of Light, Jaden discovered that many more students were under the same spell.
Alexis challenged Jaden to a duel. Jaden knew that the only way he could save his friend from the Society of Light was to defeat her.
I have to duel her. It’s the only way to set her free.
I accept your challenge, so let's duel!
Smartest thing you've ever done...or maybe the dumbest.
